source_name: Asseco Central Europe – Správy / press room (news releases, SK)
why_relevant: The winning supplier's own announcement is often the only public description of contract scope, technology and duration for Slovak bank deals; Asseco publishes SK-language releases on wins and go-lives.

source_name: Asseco CE – 'Napísali o nás' (press clippings incl. 'Banky sa svojimi IT dodávateľmi nechvália')
why_relevant: Directly documents the structural problem of this cell — Slovak banks conceal their IT suppliers — and names vendors/relationships in the process. Excellent seed for actor mapping and for understanding disclosure incentives.

source_name: Forbes Slovensko – article on Slovak banks not naming IT suppliers
why_relevant: Independent business-press mapping of who supplies which Slovak bank; supplies vendor names to add to the actor map and is a recurring outlet for vendor-side disclosure.

source_name: Global Payments Slovensko – corporate site & document library
why_relevant: Dominant Slovak card acquirer (ex-VÚB/Slovenská sporiteľňa acquiring). Its SK site publishes contract templates, sadzobníky (rate schedules) and partner-bank pages, revealing acquiring distribution deals with banks and pricing terms tied to those contracts.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa – Global Payments partner page (bank-side confirmation of acquirer deal)
why_relevant: Rare case where the buyer bank publicly names its payments supplier; confirms an acquiring distribution relationship that would otherwise only appear on the vendor side.

source_name: Euronet Worldwide – investor news releases (ATM outsourcing wins incl. Slovakia)
why_relevant: Euronet announces multiyear ATM outsourcing contracts with named banks; a confirmed Slovak example exists (Tatra banka ATM outsourcing, ~120 ATMs). IR releases give scope, duration and volume that Slovak sources never disclose.
Local entity site for Euronet Services Slovakia; useful for footprint, service lines and local contacts that anchor the Slovak ATM outsourcing actor map.

source_name: Worldline – press releases / financial press releases
why_relevant: Worldline announces long-term issuing/acquiring deals with CEE banking groups (e.g. KBC — parent of ČSOB SK; Komerční banka in CZ) whose scope frequently extends to Slovak subsidiaries; the vendor release is the only place scope and duration appear.

Nexi (incl. former Nets/Concardis assets) is an active CEE consolidator of bank acquiring portfolios; its releases are the primary public record of any Slovak bank merchant-acquiring carve-out or partnership.

source_name: Printec Group – Slovakia country page & solutions/case studies
why_relevant: Printec Slovakia supplies ATMs (NCR), POS terminals, kiosks and outsourcing to Slovak banks; its country and case-study pages describe deployed technology and, indirectly, which bank estates it services.
Long-established Slovak integrator with banking/insurance as a core vertical (34+ years, 400+ staff); its industry and reference pages reveal bank sourcing relationships that banks do not announce.

source_name: DATALAN – Prípadové štúdie (case studies incl. banking)
why_relevant: DATALAN publishes named and anonymised banking case studies (mobile banking, instalment sales via app, WAF protection for the banking sector, bank intranet), which expose project scope and technology stacks at Slovak banks.

source_name: Alanata a.s. – References page (NBS, Tatra banka, SLSP, VÚB)
why_relevant: Alanata (Slovak integrator, DATALAN lineage) explicitly lists NBS and the three largest Slovak banks among its clients — a direct disclosure of buyer relationships and an entry point to project-level detail.

source_name: PosAm – Referencie (e.g. Tatra banka IT outsourcing case)
why_relevant: PosAm publishes a named Tatra banka outsourcing reference describing the 2014 tender and 2015 transition — a concrete vendor-side disclosure of a Slovak bank procurement outcome and timeline.

Trade-association member directory enumerates Slovak IT suppliers (incl. banking integrators) with profiles — the cheapest way to expand the vendor actor map beyond the seed list before crawling each vendor's reference pages.

source_name: Diebold Nixdorf – SEC filings & press releases (Slovak footprint via merger record)
why_relevant: Vendor regulatory filings give contract/backlog commentary; and the SK competition authority's merger file identifies the Slovak channel structure (Wincor Nixdorf Slovakia entity; Diebold distributed via Spherix s.r.o. for financial self-service to banks) — key for knowing which legal entity would win an ATM contract.

source_name: TOUCHIT.sk BrandIT – vendor press-release wire (tlačový servis)
why_relevant: Slovak tech-media press-release service where vendors publish their own announcements verbatim; a low-friction aggregation point for SK-language supplier announcements about bank projects.

source_name: SITA.sk – company news wire, bank/vendor tags
why_relevant: Slovak news agency republishes corporate announcements per company tag; vendor and bank tags allow tracking of deal announcements (e.g. Tatra banka digital-euro pilot) where neither party issues an indexed press page.

source_name: FinStat.sk / FinReg.sk – Slovak vendor entity & published-contract records
why_relevant: Resolves the exact Slovak legal entity behind each international vendor (Global Payments s.r.o. organizačná zložka, Loomis SK ex-G4S, Euronet Services Slovakia) and, via FinReg, surfaces published contracts — essential for matching vendor press claims to award records.
